notificationPreferences.title: Notification preferences
notificationPreferences.description: Control which types of notifications the system creates for your organization.
notificationPreferences.comingSoonNote: This notification type is not yet available.
notificationPreferences.hint: When a type is disabled, the system will not create new notifications of that type. Existing unread notifications remain in the list.

descriptions.DOCUMENT_AUTHORIZED: Created automatically when SRI authorizes a document. Multiple authorizations within a 60-second window are grouped into a single notification.
descriptions.CERT_EXPIRING: Created when an issuer's P12 certificate is within 30 days of expiry. Updated automatically and dismissed when the certificate is renewed.
descriptions.CERT_EXPIRED: Created when an issuer's P12 certificate has already expired. Prevents issuing new documents until renewed.
descriptions.SRI_SUBMISSION_FAILED: Will be created when SRI permanently rejects a submission after all retries are exhausted.
descriptions.EMAIL_DELIVERY_FAILED: Will be created when Mailgun reports a permanent email delivery failure.
descriptions.QUOTA_WARNING: Will be created when your organization is approaching its monthly document quota.
descriptions.PAYMENT_VERIFIED: Created when your provider verifies a payment proof you uploaded — initial subscription, tier change, or renewal.
descriptions.PAYMENT_REJECTED: Created when your provider rejects a payment proof. Includes the rejection reason.
descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_RENEWAL_DUE: Created about 7 days before your current billing period ends, with renewal details.
descriptions.SUBSCRIPTION_EXPIRED: Created if your subscription expires with no verified renewal — your plan automatically drops to Free.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.description: Register HTTPS URLs to receive real-time notifications. Comprobify will POST a signed payload to each active endpoint when an event occurs.

canonical.title: In-app notifications
canonical.description: Turn this on so notifications (authorized invoices, certificates about to expire, etc.) arrive immediately instead of waiting for the periodic check.
canonical.confirmDeactivate: Deactivate real-time notifications? They'll keep arriving via periodic check instead.
canonical.httpsRequired: Requires a public HTTPS URL — won't work with localhost in local development.

webhooks.confirmDelete: Delete this endpoint? It will stop receiving notifications immediately.
webhooks.verifyDescription: Every request includes X-Comprobify-Signature and X-Comprobify-Timestamp headers. Use HMAC-SHA256 with your secret to verify the signature before processing the event.

hero.title: Electronic invoicing for Ecuador, made simple
hero.subtitle: Issue, sign, and authorize invoices and tax documents with the SRI. Use our web app or integrate the API directly into your system.

api.title: API for developers
api.description: Integrate electronic invoice generation directly into your application. REST API with token authentication, real-time webhooks, and full documentation.

web.title: Web application
web.description: Create and send invoices, credit notes, and withholding receipts from your browser with zero code. Designed for non-technical teams.
